name: Product performance
prompt: Product performance: revenue by category, the best-selling products, unit and margin breakdowns, and a product detail table.

binding.sql: SELECT category AS category, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM product_performance GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC

copy.title: Revenue by category
copy.caption: Home and Sports each clear $740K; the six categories stay within a tight band.

binding.sql: SELECT product AS product, ROUND(revenue,0) AS revenue FROM product_performance ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

copy.title: Best-selling products
copy.caption: The top ten products are clustered closely on revenue — no single runaway hit.

binding.sql: SELECT category AS category, SUM(units_sold) AS units FROM product_performance GROUP BY category ORDER BY units DESC

copy.title: Units by category
copy.caption: Unit volume is spread evenly across categories, mirroring revenue.

binding.sql: SELECT category AS category, ROUND(SUM(margin),0) AS margin FROM product_performance GROUP BY category ORDER BY margin DESC

copy.title: Margin by category
copy.caption: Home contributes the most gross margin; Toys and Beauty the least.

binding.sql: SELECT product AS product, category AS category, ROUND(price,2) AS price, units_sold AS units_sold, ROUND(revenue,0) AS revenue, ROUND(margin,0) AS margin FROM product_performance ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 50

copy.title: Product detail
copy.caption: Every product with its price, units sold, revenue and gross margin.
